web_listen_address.description: The address and port on which the exporter exposes metrics (e.g., ':9253' or '127.0.0.1:9253').

metrics_path.description: Path under which metrics are exposed (commonly '/metrics').

fpm_status_path.description: The default path to PHP-FPM status endpoint on each pool (e.g., '/status' if accessible at pool-url/status).

scrape_timeout.description: Global scrape timeout for the exporter when connecting to PHP-FPM pools (e.g., '5s').

fpm_ping_path.description: Optional custom path to PHP-FPM ping endpoint (e.g., '/ping') for liveness checks. Leave empty to use default '/ping'.

fpm_pool_pattern.description: Regex pattern to auto-discover PHP-FPM pools via process name matching. Leave empty to disable auto-discovery.

fpm_scrape_interval.description: Global scrape interval override (e.g., '30s'). Leave empty to use the exporter default.

fpm_scrape_timeout.description: Per-pool scrape timeout override (e.g., '2s'). Leave empty to fall back to 'scrape_timeout'.

fpm_pools.description: Legacy comma-separated list of pool URLs (deprecated). Prefer using `pools` instead.

pools.description: List of PHP-FPM pools to explicitly scrape. Each pool must include at least a name and URL.

url.description: Full HTTP(S) endpoint of the pool's status page (e.g., 'http://127.0.0.1:9000/status').

user.description: Basic auth username for the pool endpoint (if required). Leave blank for no auth.

password.description: Basic auth password for the pool endpoint (if required). Leave blank for no auth.
